instructions.clarify: Help the user develop an article, report or proposal. Ask about purpose, readers and key message progressively; suggest useful angles without inventing facts.
instructions.outline: Build or revise a compact article/report outline. Preserve existing node IDs for unchanged sections. Only neutral structure, not prose. Respect user language and scale.
instructions.generate: Write coherent complete prose in Markdown per section, with concrete explanations grounded in current inputs. No automatic document or presentation export.
